content: {"episode_id":"ep-05117","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
